@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+from gettext import gettext as _
+
+from .types import BoolParamType
+
+if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from .core import Context
+    from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class SemicolonBooleanStates(BoolParamType):
+    """A :class:`~click.types.BoolParamType` that separates the recognized
+    boolean state names with ``"; "`` in its error message.
+    """
+
+    def convert(
+        self, value: t.Any, param: Parameter | None, ctx: Context | None
+    ) -> bool:
+        normalized = self.str_to_bool(value)
+        if normalized is None:
+            self.fail(
+                _(
+                    "{value!r} is not a valid boolean. Recognized values: {states}"
+                ).format(value=value, states="; ".join(sorted(self.bool_states))),
+                param,
+                ctx,
+            )
+        return normalized
diff --git a/tests/test_semicolon_boolean_states.py b/tests/test_semicolon_boolean_states.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..439da45
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_semicolon_boolean_states.py
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.semicolon_boolean_states import SemicolonBooleanStates
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("value", "expect"),
+    [("yes", True), (" OFF ", False), ("", False), (True, True), (False, False)],
+)
+def test_convert_valid(value, expect):
+    assert SemicolonBooleanStates().convert(value, None, None) is expect
+
+
+def test_convert_invalid_message():
+    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter) as exc_info:
+        SemicolonBooleanStates().convert("maybe", None, None)
+
+    states = "; ".join(sorted(SemicolonBooleanStates.bool_states))
+    assert exc_info.value.message == (
+        f"'maybe' is not a valid boolean. Recognized values: {states}"
+    )
+    assert ", " not in exc_info.value.message
+
+
+def test_is_bool_param_type():
+    t = SemicolonBooleanStates()
+    assert isinstance(t, click.types.BoolParamType)
+    assert t.name == "boolean"
+    assert repr(t) == "BOOL"
notes:
Added SemicolonBooleanStates(BoolParamType) whose convert copies BoolParamType.convert (the reference does not call super()) and joins the sorted bool_states with "; " in the error message; added tests in tests/test_semicolon_boolean_states.py.
